question.text: A 67-year-old man has a palpable expansive epigastric mass and thoracic back pain. His BP is normal and the chest X-ray shows gross mediastinal widening. Most appropriate investigation?
question.say: A sixty-seven-year-old man is admitted with a palpable, expansive epigastric mass and thoracic back pain. His blood pressure is normal, and the chest X-ray shows gross widening of the mediastinum. Select the most appropriate investigation.

answer.say: The answer is an immediate CT chest scan.
